title: project migrate
description: The answer of e-designer project migrate: one project's files brought up one level, from the form before to the current one, each file's step said (ADR-S16), or nothing to do. A file two or more levels older, newer, or unreadable is refused and nothing is written.

apiVersion.description: Always elderlygate/designer/app/v1: the form of e-designer's answers. An app's answers keep the family app (apiversion/v1/forms.yaml), apart from the files they describe.

kind.description: Always ProjectMigrate, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

ran.description: Where the answer came from; this contract fixes the app and the contract version, so an answer from anything else fails here.

app.description: Always designer, e-designer's product ID, since only e-designer gives this answer.

contract.description: Always v1, the contract version this schema belongs to.

data.description: The project, and what migrating did or would do to each file, or why there was nothing to do.

project.description: The project migrated, as this machine lists it, so a reader knows which one when several are listed.

name.description: The project's name on this machine's list.

folder.description: The project's folder on this machine.

nothing.description: Why there was nothing to migrate, in words for people: every file is in its current form; present only then, and then files is empty and steps absent.

files.description: Each file's step, design by design, in the order they run: empty when there was nothing to do.

steps.description: Each command the migration ran, in order; present only on a real run, never on --dry-run, so a reader sees where a run stopped.
